chunks: And Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding one who was performing tawaf around the House, then the entering of the Kaʿbah occurred to him, so he entered it, he said: “He restarts his tawaf from the beginning.”

key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: around the House, referring to the Kaʿbah
key_terms.يَسْتَقْبِلُ: he begins anew or starts afresh

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone enters the Kaʿbah during tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning tawaf during hajj or ʿumrah. If a person enters the Kaʿbah while in the middle of tawaf, the tawaf is to be begun again from the start.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2797 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari, from Abu Abdullah (as),
regarding someone who is performing tawaf around the Kaaba and then enters the Kaaba during the tawaf. Imam (as) said: "He must start his tawaf over from the beginning."
